calls.reason: CoreWeave's 10-K leaves about $1.7B of 2025 revenue outside Microsoft. It doesn't show how much came from OpenAI, Meta or other excluded buyers. Lambda's figure is an annualized rate, so the packet sets no clear figure above or below $1B.

'Very small' has no threshold. CoreWeave's concentration on Microsoft fits the claim, while Meta's $14.2B commitment and Google's other cloud customers point the other way. Nothing in the packet measures realized compute demand outside the two labs.

No major AI company clearly died before the evaluation date. Character.AI's Chapter 11 is a doubtful fit and came two weeks before evaluation, and OpenAI raised a record round, so the predicted effects can't be judged yet.

The forecast has no deadline ('eventually'). An October 2026 tracker found no public default on a GPU-backed loan, and Oracle's force-majeure notice on Project Jupiter shows stress but not a missed loan payment.
This is an undated forecast. The October 2026 AI sell-off and FactSet's hypothetical stress tests don't measure a completed collapse that could be compared with the dot-com losses.

The contract's delivery and payment schedule is unknown. Reports of Oracle delays were denied by Oracle, and SoftBank's $22.5B closing adds funding but doesn't prove OpenAI can pay, so both halves remain unproven.
